Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax credit for fifty percent of the amount paid for health insurance premiums.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax credit for fiftypercent of the amount paid for health insurance premiums; and adding anew section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person conducting business as a sole proprietorship may creditagainst the tax imposed by this chapter, fifty percent of the valuepaid during the reporting period for health insurance premiums. Thecredit may not exceed the tax otherwise due under this chapter for thereporting period. Unused credit may be carried over and used insubsequent tax reporting periods. No refunds are granted for creditsunder this section.
